name: Cleaner Core for Muse
status: draft: the server's Muse profile is built; needs the live re-test in README.md before a host uses it
hostedCleanerCoreUrlNote: The one Cleaner Core service every host and chat uses. Saad adds each host on its /admin page and sends them an invite code.

repository.note: Muse clones the repository on its cloud computer only to read and save the skill. It never runs Cleaner Core from the clone.

deployment.note: The one multi-tenant Cleaner Core service every chat shares. Each host's chat, number, and keys come from its tenant, never from these variables.

integrations.name: Cleaner Core
integrations.auth: OAuth 2.1 discovered from the Cleaner Core service. The host types the invite code from Saad on the Cleaner Core page and clicks Allow. Muse cannot approve itself.
integrations.where: Muse creates it from the chat. Fallback: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
integrations.approvals: Set to run without asking each time, so the recurring task doesn't stop at a prompt nobody sees. Cleaner Core asks the host itself before the door code, a text, a pause, or a reset.

integrations.name: Google Calendar
integrations.auth: The host connects their own Google account to Muse's Google Calendar connector. Muse reads the events and passes them to Cleaner Core. Cleaner Core never gets a Google approval.

routines.name: Cleaner Core
routines.where: A Muse recurring task, created by Muse in the setup chat
triggers: schedule (the host picks: every minute, 5 minutes, 15 minutes, or hour)

secretsGoTo: Cleaner Core's private page behind each one-time upload link, opened in Muse's own browser and typed there by the host. Muse's secure credential store holds only sign-ins and API keys, so it isn't used. Never chat, a card, or a tool argument.
calendarLinks: The host picks: I have the link (the host pastes it on the private page in Muse's browser), or Find it for me (the host signs in on Muse's browser, Muse finds the listing's export link, and pastes it into the private page).
neverIncluded: Cleaner Core connector or OAuth tokens
Google OAuth access or refresh tokens
host, cleaner, or contact phone numbers
live booking, cleaning, message, or photo records
